skill.name: multi-source-research
skill.description: Coordinate quick, standard, or extensive research across web, documentation, and code sources, then synthesize findings with confidence labels.
skill.summary: Research web, local documentation, and code in parallel, then synthesize findings with source-based confidence labels.
skill.author: Consiliency

content.value_statement: Complex questions often require current web sources, local documentation, and code evidence. This skill coordinates those sources and presents findings with confidence labels.
actual_capabilities: Selects quick, standard, or extensive research based on the requested depth.
Coordinates parallel research across web, local documentation, and code sources.
Labels findings as high, medium, low, or conflicting confidence.
Reports sources, implementation notes, conflicts, and incomplete research.
limitations: Web research requires network access and may encounter rate limits or paywalls.
Quick mode uses limited source coverage and may miss nuance.
Extensive mode uses more time and model resources.
Confidence labels depend on source agreement and do not guarantee accuracy.

use_cases.title: Verify a Current Fact
use_cases.description: Check a focused claim against web results and local documentation, then return a concise answer with sources.
use_cases.target_user: Analysts needing a fast fact check

use_cases.title: Research an Implementation
use_cases.description: Compare current guidance with local documentation and code examples before selecting an implementation approach.

use_cases.title: Support an Architecture Decision
use_cases.description: Investigate alternatives from several perspectives, identify disagreements, and synthesize evidence for a major decision.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Fact Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Use quick mode to verify [claim] and provide the answer, source links, and a confidence label.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused answer with minimal delay.

prompt_templates.title: Standard Technical Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Use standard mode to research [technical question] across web, documentation, and code, then summarize findings and implementation notes.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs balanced research before implementing a feature.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [option A] and [option B], compare tradeoffs, cite supporting sources, and identify conflicting evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs evidence for a technology choice.

prompt_templates.title: Extensive Decision Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use extensive mode to assess [decision], covering current guidance, local constraints, code evidence, conflicts, recommendations, and further research.
prompt_templates.scenario: A technical leader needs a comprehensive, cross-validated decision brief.

output_examples.input: Use quick mode to verify whether the selected library still receives maintenance updates.
output_examples.output: The library remains actively maintained. Two recent release sources agree, while local documentation references an older version. Confidence: medium.

output_examples.input: Compare two authentication approaches using standard mode.
output: Summary: Both approaches are supported, but they differ in revocation, storage, and operational complexity.
Key finding: Official guidance and local code favor the first approach for this project.
Conflict: Community sources disagree about performance benefits.
Confidence: High for compatibility and medium for performance.

output_examples.input: Prepare extensive research for a database migration decision.
output_examples.output: The report compares alternatives, maps evidence to project constraints, records conflicting claims, recommends a staged migration, and lists open validation tasks.

best_practices: State the research question, required depth, and decision context.
Prefer primary sources and verify important claims across multiple sources.
Review conflicting and low-confidence findings before acting.
anti_patterns: Do not use quick mode for complex architecture decisions.
Do not treat source count alone as proof of correctness.
Do not omit project constraints when requesting implementation guidance.

faq.question: Which research mode should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose quick for simple checks, standard for technical questions, and extensive for major comparisons or decisions.

faq.question: What sources can the skill use?
faq.answer: It can coordinate web search, local documentation search, and codebase search when those tools and sources are available.

faq.question: How are confidence labels assigned?
faq.answer: Labels reflect source agreement: high for three or more agreeing sources, medium for two, and low for one.

faq.question: What happens when sources disagree?
faq.answer: The report marks the finding as conflicting and presents the disagreement for manual review.

faq.question: Can research continue without web access?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can return documentation-only or code-only findings and note the missing web coverage.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee current and accurate results?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on source quality, access, and coverage, so important claims still require review.
